summary_en: Hulic, which owns 50.87% of Riso Kyoiku Group, launched a tender offer for all outstanding common shares and six series of warrants to acquire 100% ownership and delist the company from the Prime Market.
title_en: Notice of Expression of Opinion in Support of and Recommendation to Tender in Public Tender Offer for our Common Shares and Warrants by Hulic, Our Parent Company
translation_en_brief: On October 13, 2026, Riso Kyoiku Group's board of directors expressed its support for and recommended shareholders and warrant holders to tender their shares and warrants in a public tender offer initiated by Hulic Corporation, the company's controlling parent. Hulic currently owns 86,885,599 shares, representing 50.87% of the company (calculated on a basis that includes shares underlying outstanding warrants and excludes treasury shares totaling 170,815,350 shares on a fully diluted basis as of August 31, 2026). The tender offer encompasses all issued common shares and six series of stock acquisition rights (warrants) issued between October 2018 and October 2023 for employee compensation purposes. The board resolved to support the transaction with the explicit understanding that Hulic intends to acquire 100% ownership of the company through the tender offer and subsequent procedures, resulting in delisting from the Tokyo Stock Exchange Prime Market. The offer also encompasses multiple series of warrants with various exercise periods extending to 2063. Specific pricing and tender period details were not disclosed in this preliminary announcement of the board's support.
